content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for `auth-service` (JWT validation errors > 5% in 1m): PD-INC-7421
pagerduty: Triggered: Auth JWT errors spike — escalation to oncall @sam.g
sam.g: acked oncall pagerduty (ack by sam.g)
sam.g: looking at logs now, initial error is `{"error":"kid not found","count":412}` across regions
maria.r: I'm seeing a sudden influx of token validation failures from prod-api (token introspect OK but signature mismatch)
alex.k: @sam.g any config pushes to JWKS recently? I didn't touch the key rotation code.
sam.g: no scheduled deploys in last hour. Checking JWKS propagation and CDN cache.
oncall: paging in channel, assigning incident lead to sam.g
jessica.t: customer success reporting 5 customers with 401s, starting takedown list
sam.g: reproducing: curl to auth's JWKS endpoint shows older key set cached at edge
sam.g: possible explanation: our global cache TTL was bumped in CDN config — edge has stale JWKS which causes `kid` mismatch
maria.r: can we fallback to local cached keys in auth-service meanwhile? There's code to accept keys from internal store when JWKS fetch fails.
alex.k: yes, we can flip a feature flag to enable local key fallback. Command: `POST /ops/feature-flags/auth-jwks-fallback enable --env=prod`
sam.g: preparing to toggle fallback, will notify before flip. Also initiating a cache purge for jwks/* on CDN.
support-bot: Notifying affected customers: CS ticket created #CS-9872 with template 'jwt-401s'
sam.g: purge initiated: `aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id ABCD1234 --paths /jwks/*` — invalidation submitted
maria.r: enabling fallback now (rolling): `curl -XPOST https://ops-api/flags -d '{"flag":"auth-jwks-fallback","state":"on"}'` — change propagated to auth instances
sam.g: monitoring auth logs. Error rate dropping from 6.8% -> 1.2% in 2 minutes
pagerduty: Escalation suppressed (acknowledged by sam.g). Next oncall: @alex.k if re-escalation.
jessica.t: CS updated customers: instructing them to retry. Adding note: no user credential change required — transient verification mismatch
alex.k: CDN invalidation completed (status: InProgress) — should finish within 2-3 minutes
sam.g: once CDN invalidation completes, we'll disable fallback and verify JWKS aligns. Plan: disable fallback after 10m stable
maria.r: quick sanity: added monitoring alert to detect JWKS staleness divergence > 1 key in 5m
support-bot: Incident timeline ticket created IT-3112, assigning to sam.g for postmortem
sam.g: CDN invalidation finished; upstream JWKS shows updated keys and token verification success across regions
sam.g: disabling fallback now and monitoring: `POST /ops/feature-flags/auth-jwks-fallback disable --env=prod`
alex.k: watching for errors — none at 3m after revert
jessica.t: CS: customers acknowledged recovery, leaving follow-up with engineering for RCA
sam.g: root cause: unintended increase in CDN TTL for `/jwks/*` during unrelated config change; fallback prevented prolonged outage. Action items: 1) add CI check to prevent jwks cache TTL > 60s 2) automate invalidation on key rotations 3) run a drill next week. Assigning items.
maria.r: adding those to IT-3112 and linking runbook updates
sam.g: incident declared resolved. Closing pagerduty incident PD-INC-7421 — resolved by sam.g
incident-bot: Incident resolved: PD-INC-7421 — duration ~12m
sam.g: thanks all :thumbsup:
jessica.t: great quick response team, will send customer-facing summary later
